firstPlayerRule: Shuffle the players’ offering markers and place them randomly on the turn track. Follow that order when making the first offerings to the Gods.
clarifications: Action turns follow the order of the Gods after bidding, so the first bidder is not necessarily first to perform actions.
With two players, shuffle both offering markers from each player onto the turn track; each player bids for two Gods.
